name: xbrain-design
description: A general design plugin: named styles and themes, patterns and a glossary of their parameters, the decisions and hooks that make designs strong with how to build them, choosing a direction by the product's type, UX rules and checklists, motion, design systems with Cyrillic type, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), and the XBrain brain's designs (canvas, versions, build from a design, comments, sync, visual QA).
